name: CaseGridTrackZeroValue
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "grid-track-zero-value" (grid-tracks). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: a 0px or 0fr track written to the canvas
